help_commands:
I can help you manage your freelance jobs and contracts.

*Getting Started*
/start - Sign in and open the Mini App
/login - Get a one-time code to sign in on the web
/account - Show which Yekis account you are signed in as
/menu - Show main interactive menu
/language - Change your language

*Work & Jobs*
/jobs - Browse and bid on jobs
/contracts - Manage active contracts

*Finance & Account*
/wallet - Check balance & withdraw
/kyc - Identity verification
/disputes - Raise or manage disputes

/help - Show this message again
